response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
    SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_record_count
    FROM scanqc
    GROUP BY arcref
),
project_shares AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_record_count,
        qc_record_count::numeric / SUM(qc_record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM project_counts
),
project_deviations AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_record_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM project_shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_record_count, share, deviation
FROM project_deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Projects in the QC data” means projects with at least one scanqc record; projects with no QC records are excluded from the shares and average.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every project, including those with no QC records, in the average share and rank; projects without QC records have a count and share of zero.
alternatives.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
    SELECT p.arcregistry AS arcref, COUNT(q.qualregistry) AS qc_record_count
    FROM projects p
    LEFT JOIN scanqc q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
    GROUP BY p.arcregistry
),
project_shares AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_record_count,
        qc_record_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(qc_record_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM project_counts
),
project_deviations AS (
    SELECT
        arcref,
        qc_record_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM project_shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_record_count, share, deviation
FROM project_deviations
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
